test_title: PYST 03: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 05 Jun, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRSs), the Government of India's education initiatives for tribal communities, were introduced in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1997-98**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRSs)** were introduced by the Government of India in the year **1997-98** to provide quality education to tribal students.
 
• The scheme was launched under the Ministry of Tribal Affairs to ensure access to education for Scheduled Tribe (ST) students in remote areas.
 
• EMRSs aim to provide holistic education from Class VI to XII, with an emphasis on both academic and extracurricular activities.
 
• Each school is equipped to accommodate 480 students, providing free education, boarding, and lodging facilities to the students.
 
• The government has set a target of establishing one EMRS in every block with a significant tribal population (at least 50% ST population and 20,000 tribal people).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Objective of EMRSs:**

 
 
• To promote the educational advancement of Scheduled Tribe (ST) children by providing quality education in a residential setup.
 
• To enable students to access opportunities in higher education and employment.
 
 
 
• **Salient Features of EMRSs:**
 
 
• Schools are set up with modern infrastructure, including hostels, libraries, and sports facilities.
 
• Focus on preserving tribal culture and heritage alongside mainstream education.
 
• Students are provided free uniforms, textbooks, and stationery.
 
 
 
• **Expansion Goals:**
 
 
• By 2025, the government aims to establish 740 EMRSs across the country to cater to tribal students.
 
• This will ensure a greater reach and reduce educational inequalities for tribal communities.
 
 
 
• **Associated Schemes:**
 
 
• EMRSs are a part of the government's larger initiative to support tribal development, alongside schemes like the Tribal Sub-Plan and Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana.
 
• Additional scholarships and support programs are also provided to students to promote higher education.
